title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE - HUNTER
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE/MANAGER HUNTER/CLOSER £74 K OTE ASHFORD

Diamond Search Recruitment are delighted to be exclusively representing our client in the appointment of an ambitious, energetic and commercially driven Business Development Executive.

Location: Ashford, Kent
Salary: £45,000 basic + uncapped commission
OTE: £74,000

Ready to Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level?

Are you a natural hunter / closer?

Someone who thrives on the chase, loves winning business and gets a genuine buzz from turning a great conversation into a signed order?

Do you have big career ambitions, great energy and the determination to make serious money through your own performance?

If so, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Diamond Search Recruitment are working exclusively on behalf of our client, a rapidly growing product manufacturing business.

Due to continued growth, they are looking for a driven Business Development Executive who wants to build a successful sales career, take ownership of a valuable pipeline and become a key commercial player within the business.

And here's the exciting part

You're not starting from zero.

Forget spending your days trawling LinkedIn, buying databases and making hundreds of completely cold calls.

You'll be handed a pipeline of highly qualified opportunities from customers who are already exploring product development and are interested in taking their ideas into manufacturing.

We're looking for someone who can pick up the phone, build instant rapport, uncover the opportunity, overcome objections and close the deal.

THE ROLE

This is a genuinely exciting hunter-style sales position.

You'll manage approximately new qualified opportunities every month, speaking directly with entrepreneurs, start-ups and established brands looking to bring new products to market.

Your job is simple:

Build relationships. Create momentum. Solve problems. Close business.

You'll have regular telephone and video conversations with customers, understanding what they're trying to achieve, their budget and requirements, and then working with them to develop a commercially viable solution.

You'll learn the technical side of the industry as you go.

Full training will be provided across the company's products, pricing structures, systems and manufacturing processes.

What you DO need is:

Energy. Confidence. Commercial instinct. Ambition. Resilience. And the ability to ask for the order.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Take ownership of a high-quality pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
- Conduct frequent telephone and video consultations with prospective customers.
- Build strong relationships quickly and establish credibility with decision-makers.
- Identify customer needs, budgets and commercial objectives.
- Qualify opportunities and keep customers moving through the sales journey.
- Identify potential obstacles and find commercially viable solutions.
- Present pricing and proposals confidently.
- Negotiate and overcome objections.
- Follow up relentlessly and professionally.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline activity.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure customer requirements can be delivered.
- Convert qualified opportunities into manufacturing orders.
- Consistently work towards and exceed sales targets.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We're not looking for someone who simply wants another sales job.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in sales.

You might already be working in:
- Business Development
- B2 B Sales
- Account Management
- Telesales
- Technology Sales
- Another target-driven commercial environment

Or perhaps you're a naturally competitive, commercially minded salesperson who knows you're capable of much more.

Industry experience isn't essential.

What matters is that you are:

Ambitious you want to progress and earn well.
Energetic you bring enthusiasm to every conversation.
Confident you're comfortable speaking to customers and decision-makers.
Hungry you want to win, not simply participate.
Resilient you don't crumble when you hear "no".
Commercial you understand that conversations need to lead somewhere.
Curious you enjoy learning and asking great questions.
Competitive you want to be one of the best performers.
Career-focused you're serious about where your sales career can take you.

Most importantly, you're comfortable asking for the business.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

£45,000 Basic + £74,000 OTE

Your earning potential is directly linked to your performance, giving you the opportunity to significantly increase your earnings as you develop.
- Qualified Leads

You won't be expected to build your entire pipeline from scratch.

You'll be working with qualified opportunities every month, giving you a strong platform from which to generate sales.
- No Traditional Cold Calling

This is a proactive sales role, but you won't spend your day making endless calls to completely cold prospects.

The conversations you're having are with customers who have already shown an interest in developing and manufacturing products.
- Career Development

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation where ambition is encouraged.

If you're successful, there is genuine scope to develop your responsibilities and progress your career.
- Full Product Training

You don't need technical knowledge of the products or manufacturing process.

You'll receive comprehensive training and learn everything you need to become a confident and credible commercial advisor.
- An Exciting Industry

You'll be working with entrepreneurs and established brands bringing new products to market.

Every customer and project is different, meaning this is far from a repetitive sales environment.

THE IDEAL PERSON

We're looking for someone who walks into the office with energy and ambition.

Someone who enjoys being busy.

Someone who likes targets.

Someone who wants to hear "yes".

Someone who can take a difficult customer conversation and turn it into an opportunity.

Someone who isn't afraid to pick up the phone, challenge a customer, negotiate and ultimately close the deal.

If you're currently in sales and thinking:

"I'm capable of earning more. I'm capable of doing more. I want a proper career."

We want to hear from you!

Interested?

If you're ambitious, energetic, commercially driven and serious about building a successful sales career, apply today.

Diamond Search Recruitment is proud to be representing our client on this exciting appointment.

title: Commercial Insurance Sales Executive
description:
Commercial Insurance Sales Executive

Gravesend £30,000 £35,000 + Commission Hybrid Working

Are you an ambitious commercial insurance sales professional who wants plenty of leads, an excellent commission structure and the opportunity to build a successful long-term career with a rapidly growing independent broker?

Our client is a family-owned commercial insurance brokerage based in Gravesend. The business has developed an excellent reputation for its personal approach, strong market relationships and expertise in arranging insurance for businesses across a range of sectors, with a particular specialism in construction.

As part of its continued growth, they are now looking for a driven and commercially minded Sales Executive with at least two years experience in commercial insurance sales.

This is a genuine sales position for someone who enjoys speaking with business owners, identifying opportunities and converting enquiries into profitable new business.

The opportunity

Our client can provide a strong flow of leads and enquiries, giving you an excellent platform from which to succeed. You will be responsible for responding quickly, understanding each prospect s insurance requirements and converting suitable opportunities into new clients.

However, the business is also looking for someone with the hunger and initiative to create opportunities of their own. You will therefore be encouraged to build relationships, generate referrals and develop your own pipeline alongside the leads provided.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Contacting and qualifying new commercial insurance leads
- Speaking with business owners to understand their risks and insurance requirements
- Converting enquiries into profitable new business
- Building strong relationships with prospects, clients and insurers
- Developing your own leads through referrals, networking and proactive business development
- Producing accurate and professional insurance documentation
- Working closely with the wider team to ensure clients receive a responsive, personal service
- Contributing to the continued growth of the brokerage

About you

To be considered, you will need:
- At least two years commercial insurance sales experience
- A good understanding of commercial insurance products
- A proven ability to convert leads and win new business
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive, persistent and highly sales-focused approach
- The confidence to speak with business owners and decision-makers
- The ability to manage a pipeline and follow opportunities through
- A genuine desire to progress your career within an ambitious independent broker

Experience working with construction clients would be advantageous, although it is not essential.

Our client is a people-focused business, so attitude and personality are just as important as technical ability. You will need to be ambitious, hardworking, positive and keen to play an active part in the company s growth.

What s on offer?
- Salary of £27,000 £35,000, depending on experience
- Commission of 10% on all income generated above an agreed threshold
- A strong supply of leads and new business opportunities
- Working hours of 9am 5pm
- Hybrid working, with Wednesdays from home
- Four days each week in modern Gravesend offices
- 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Two-week company closure over Christmas
- Workplace pension
- Regular company events and team days
- Supportive, family-owned working environment
- Genuine long-term career and earning potential

This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-growing brokerage where your contribution will be noticed, your results will be rewarded and you can build a highly successful career.

If you have commercial insurance sales experience and the hunger to take your career to the next level, we would love to hear from you.

title: Graduate Medical Sales Representative - Dermatology & Allergy
description:
Evolve Selection is exclusively partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to deliver an exciting new team build across the UK.

You'll have the opportunity to help shape and grow a developing team, build valuable relationships across primary care and make a real contribution to improving patient outcomes.

Combining scientific engagement, relationship building and commercial ownership, you'll work in partnership with healthcare professionals to identify opportunities, develop your territory and deliver meaningful value across these exciting therapeutic areas.

Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential, with training and development available to support those new to the industry.

This is a full-time, permanent position covering the South East region of the UK, with exact territory boundaries to be confirmed. Please note that a full, valid UK driving licence is essential for this role.

What s on offer?
- Highly Competitive starting salary of £35,000, plus exceptional benefits package - including bonus, car allowance, pension, holiday buy back scheme and more!
- Innovative Product Portfolio - Work with leading dermatology and allergy products in a specialist market.
- Collaborative Culture - Thrive in a supportive, people-focused environment.

Ideal Requirements:
- Open to Graduates and Entry-Level Professionals - Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and early-career professionals with transferable skills, enthusiasm and a desire to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- A Passion for Healthcare and Learning - A degree in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline is desirable, alongside a genuine interest in healthcare and a willingness to develop strong clinical and product knowledge. We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and graduates with transferable skills who are keen to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- Strong Relationship-Building and Communication Skills - The ability to build credible, lasting relationships with healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders. You will be confident communicating, influencing and adapting your approach to meet different customer needs.
- Commercial Awareness and a Drive to Succeed - A proactive, results-focused mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, work towards objectives and contribute to business growth. Previous experience in a target-driven commercial or healthcare environment would be advantageous.
- Self-Motivation and Effective Territory Management - The confidence and initiative to work independently, manage your time effectively and take ownership of a geographical territory. You will be organised, adaptable and comfortable planning your activities to maximise opportunities.
- A Commitment to Professional Excellence - A commitment to working ethically and responsibly within the pharmaceutical industry. An understanding of the ABPI Code, previous pharmaceutical sales experience and an ABPI qualification would be advantageous, although support and development will be available for candidates new to the industry.

Role Responsibilities:
- Build Meaningful Healthcare Partnerships - Develop trusted, long-term relationships with GPs, practice-based clinicians, community pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, becoming a valued partner and a recognised source of clinical and product expertise within your territory.
- Drive Territory Growth and Commercial Success - Take ownership of your territory, identifying new opportunities, developing strategic business plans and using sales data and market insights to maximise growth, achieve sales targets and deliver outstanding commercial results.
- Deliver Engaging, Clinically Relevant Customer Conversations - Bring clinical evidence to life through high-quality, tailored discussions that demonstrate the benefits, appropriate use and value of specialist products, supporting healthcare professionals to make informed decisions that benefit patients.
- Shape Local Healthcare Opportunities Through Collaboration - Work closely with internal colleagues and cross-functional teams to develop effective engagement strategies, strengthen local partnerships and align product offerings with NHS priorities and evolving patient needs, including opportunities within Pharmacy First.
- Champion Professional Excellence and Patient Outcomes - Operate with integrity and professionalism, maintaining excellent clinical and product knowledge while ensuring all activities meet ABPI and regulatory standards. Keep patients at the heart of every interaction and ensure responsible use of resources.

Recruitment Process:

2 stage interview and assessment process

Interview with a hiring manager who is a passionate and experienced leader, values your ideas, mentors your growth, and is committed to helping you succeed in this role.

Excited to learn more? Click apply or reach out to our recruitment team for full details!

Application Process:

Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.

Evolve is a leading recruitment and outsourcing organisation, operating within the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Device and Life Science sectors.

Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success as a company, We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.
